name: Coral bleaching
summary: No global bleaching event in progress; El Niño heat stress building in the Caribbean
state: The fourth global coral bleaching event was declared over in June 2026. Caribbean Coral Reef Watch bulletins from the summer flagged rising heat stress, and NOAA has warned that El Niño could bring more widespread bleaching (CIMH; CBS News). No new regional mass bleaching had been confirmed as of 5 Nov.
for_you: No direct action needed; reef-dependent fisheries and tourism are most exposed if bleaching spreads.
rubric_hit: No global or regional mass bleaching event = Normal

sources.title: CIMH — Caribbean Coral Reef Watch bulletin, August 2026
CBS News — El Niño could bring more widespread coral bleaching, NOAA warns

why: Reefs support a quarter of marine species and coastal economies; mass bleaching is a direct sign of ocean heat stress.
drivers: Marine heatwaves, El Niño, warming trend.

rubric.alert: Bleaching extent at record levels with active new alerts in the past month.
rubric.watch: Global bleaching event in progress, or regional mass bleaching.
rubric.normal: No global bleaching event in progress.
